content.comment_body: Hello, Can anyone advise on how to assign outputs on an [product_name]? I can only access two analog outputs. I am using [product_name] [version_no] and planning to use a [article_no] & [product_name].

Hello, A single [product_name] only supports two analog outputs. If you need more, you will need to use a creative workaround, like adding another [product_name] in a network or using a digital-to-analog converter. Regards,
[user_name], Thank you for the answer. I was beginning to realize this is the situation.

analysis.insight_summary: Users identified that the [product_name] platform only enables access to two analog outputs per device, which limits capability when utilizing multiple expansion modules. Users must find alternatives, such as using extra controllers or hardware solutions, affecting flexibility and system scalability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to configure more than two analog outputs when operating [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] module with a [article_no] base device.
